tools.name: get_site_of_the_day
tools.description: Get today's Site of the Day: the current winner (if selected) and today's nominations with vote counts.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Get trending listings: most viewed today, most clicked this week, and most voted this month, each with title, slug and count.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all directory categories with their slugs and listing counts. Use a slug with navigate_to "/category/<slug>" to open one.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate the current page to a section of this site. Allowed path prefixes: /browse, /trending, /category/<slug>, /listing/<slug>, /tags, /categories. Relative paths only.

path.description: Relative path to open, e.g. "/browse" or "/listing/some-slug".

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Browse the directory: returns the current homepage feed of approved listings (title, slug, tagline, URL, votes, categories). Use offset/limit to page through. For deeper browsing, navigate_to "/browse".
